compositions.name: single integral handle to projective ternary symplectic image
compositions.statement: The integral handle inclusion, reduction modulo three and projectivization compose without an abstract-group identity seam.

compositions.name: Lorentz selector stabilizer into the projective Spin(2,3) carrier
compositions.statement: The lifted selector stabilizer composes with the Spin(2,3) covering map to give a homomorphism into SO_0(2,3).

compositions.name: selected Spin(2,3) subgroup into the Spin(2,4) orthogonal base
compositions.statement: The selected-direction inclusion composes with the Spin(2,4) cover.

compositions.name: order-23 cyclic factor through its declared Monster centralizer
compositions.statement: The declared C23 factor includes into C23 x S4 and then into the Monster as the order-23 centralizer subgroup.

compositions.name: faithful Standard Model global group through the SU(5) chain
compositions.statement: The faithful Standard Model global form embeds in Spin(10) through its exact S(U3 x U2) identification and the standard SU(5) subgroup.

compositions.name: colour-lepton SU(4) through the globally correct Pati-Salam subgroup
compositions.statement: The SU(4) factor maps through the central Pati-Salam quotient before entering Spin(10).

compositions.name: Spin(10) factor through the globally correct E6 maximal-rank subgroup
compositions.statement: The Spin(10) factor reaches compact E6 through the central C4 quotient required by the ambient global form.

compositions.name: three-strand braid representation followed by projectivization
compositions.statement: The standard B3 matrix representation followed by projectivization has the same endpoints as quotienting B3 by its full infinite cyclic center.

compositions.name: real rank-one spin subgroup inside the Spin(2,3) carrier
compositions.statement: The SL(2,R) model of Spin_0(1,2) embeds into Spin_0(2,3) after a signature-(1,2) section is selected.

compositions.name: rank-one spin cover through the selected orthogonal section
compositions.statement: The Spin_0(1,2) double cover followed by the selected SO_0(1,2) block inclusion maps into SO_0(2,3).

compositions.name: rank-one spin subgroup through the Spin(2,3) cover
compositions.statement: The selected Spin_0(1,2) inclusion followed by the Spin_0(2,3) covering map gives a second typed route into SO_0(2,3).

compositions.name: indefinite unitary rank-one model into the Spin(2,3) carrier
compositions.statement: Cayley conjugation identifies SU(1,1) with SL(2,R), the rank-one spin isomorphism identifies that model with Spin_0(1,2), and the selected section embeds it into Spin_0(2,3).

compositions.name: left SL(2,R) factor through Spin_0(2,2) into Spin_0(2,3)
compositions.statement: The first SL(2,R) factor enters the selected Spin_0(2,2) stabilizer and then Spin_0(2,3).

compositions.name: right SL(2,R) factor through Spin_0(2,2) into Spin_0(2,3)
compositions.statement: The second SL(2,R) factor enters the selected Spin_0(2,2) stabilizer and then Spin_0(2,3).

compositions.name: Spin(2,4) through its SU(2,2) model into the selected SU(3,3) block
compositions.statement: The exceptional global-form isomorphism identifies Spin_0(2,4) with SU(2,2), after which the selected signature-(2,2) block includes into SU(3,3).

compositions.name: real rank-two Peirce corner through Spin(2,4) and SU(2,2) into SU(3,3)
compositions.statement: The selected Spin_0(2,3) stabilizer enters Spin_0(2,4), is transported to SU(2,2), and then enters the selected SU(2,2) block of SU(3,3).

compositions.name: Spin(2) double cover expressed as a unit-circle squaring map
compositions.statement: The Spin(2) double cover followed by the rotation-to-phase isomorphism is the degree-two map z maps to z squared on U(1).

compositions.name: SU(2) factor through the central quotient U(2) into SU(3)
compositions.statement: The SU(2) factor enters the covering product, descends through its diagonal C2 quotient to U(2), and then enters SU(3) with determinant compensation.

compositions.name: central U(1) factor through U(2) into SU(3)
compositions.statement: The U(1) factor maps through U(2) to the determinant-compensated circle subgroup of SU(3).

compositions.name: SU(3) factor through the central quotient U(3) into SU(4)
compositions.statement: The SU(3) factor enters the covering product, descends through its diagonal C3 quotient to U(3), and then enters SU(4) with determinant compensation.

compositions.name: B-L-shaped U(1) factor through U(3) into SU(4)
compositions.statement: The U(1) factor maps through U(3) to the determinant-compensated circle subgroup diag(z,z,z,z^-3) of SU(4).

compositions.name: covering product through its faithful U(3) image into SU(4)
compositions.statement: SU(3) x U(1) maps onto the residual U(3) subgroup of SU(4), with diagonal C3 kernel, then embeds by determinant compensation.

compositions.name: diagonal cubic kernel through the SU(3) x U(1) quotient
compositions.statement: The diagonal C3 kernel inclusion followed by the quotient to U(3) is the trivial homomorphism.

compositions.name: nonabelian Standard Model product through the covering group and C6 quotient
compositions.statement: The nonabelian SU(3) x SU(2) product enters the unquotiented Standard Model cover at unit hypercharge and then descends injectively to the faithful C6 quotient.

compositions.name: colour SU(3) factor through the nonabelian product into the faithful Standard Model group
compositions.statement: The SU(3) factor includes into SU(3) x SU(2) and then into the faithful Standard Model global group.

compositions.name: weak SU(2) factor through the nonabelian product into the faithful Standard Model group
compositions.statement: The SU(2) factor includes into SU(3) x SU(2) and then into the faithful Standard Model global group.

compositions.name: selected axial circle through SO(3) into the first product factor
compositions.statement: A selected-axis SO(2) enters SO(3) and then the first factor of SO(3) x SO(2).

compositions.name: U(2) through S(U(1) x U(2)) into SU(3)
compositions.statement: The abstract U(2) model is transported to the determinant-one block stabilizer and included in SU(3).

compositions.name: line phase through U(1) x U(2) into U(3)
compositions.statement: The U(1) factor acts on the selected complex line and enters U(3) through the block stabilizer.

compositions.name: plane unitary factor through U(1) x U(2) into U(3)
compositions.statement: The U(2) factor acts on the complementary complex plane and enters U(3) through the block stabilizer.

compositions.name: integral symplectic lattice through the real carrier into Spin_0(2,3)
compositions.statement: Sp(4,Z) first includes in Sp(4,R), then the real Lie-group isomorphism transports its image to an arithmetic subgroup of Spin_0(2,3).

compositions.name: cyclic order-23 factor through its declared Monster centralizer
compositions.statement: The C23 factor embeds in C23 x S4 and the full centralizer includes in the Monster.

compositions.name: S4 factor through the declared order-23 Monster centralizer
compositions.statement: The S4 factor embeds in C23 x S4 and the full centralizer includes in the Monster.

compositions.name: cube subgroup through the order-nine lift to its faithful quotient
compositions.statement: The kernel inclusion followed by the quotient map is the trivial homomorphism C3 -> C3, witnessing exactness at C9.

compositions.name: order-three subgroup through C6 to the parity quotient
compositions.statement: The C3 kernel inclusion followed by the C6 parity quotient is the trivial homomorphism C3 -> C2.

compositions.name: order-two subgroup through C6 to the triality quotient
compositions.statement: The C2 kernel inclusion followed by the C6 triality quotient is the trivial homomorphism C2 -> C3.

compositions.name: braid representation through mod-two congruence to the three-letter permutation group
compositions.statement: The standard B3 representation, reduction modulo two and projective-line action compose to a surjection onto S3.

compositions.name: mod-three central quotient followed by the tetrahedral identification
compositions.statement: The named quotient SL(2,F3) -> A4 factors as projectivization followed by PSL(2,F3) ~= A4.

compositions.name: mod-five central quotient followed by the icosahedral identification
compositions.statement: The named quotient SL(2,F5) -> A5 factors as projectivization followed by PSL(2,F5) ~= A5.

compositions.name: braid representation through mod-three projectivization to the tetrahedral rotation group
compositions.statement: The standard B3 representation, reduction modulo three, projectivization and projective-line action compose to a surjection onto A4.

compositions.name: braid representation through mod-five projectivization to the icosahedral rotation group
compositions.statement: The standard B3 representation, reduction modulo five, projectivization and projective action compose to a surjection onto A5.

compositions.name: integral symplectic group through rational points to the real carrier
compositions.statement: Coefficient extension composes the inclusions Sp(4,Z) -> Sp(4,Q) -> Sp(4,R).

compositions.name: integral symplectic group through rational symplectic points into the rational linear ambient
compositions.statement: The defining representation after rational scalar extension embeds Sp(4,Z) in GL(4,Q) through Sp(4,Q).

compositions.name: integral symplectic group through integral and rational general-linear ambient groups
compositions.statement: The defining integral representation and scalar extension compose to Sp(4,Z) -> GL(4,Z) -> GL(4,Q) -> GL(4,R).

compositions.name: selected order-three turn through its pseudo-unitary envelope into the real symplectic carrier
compositions.statement: The selected finite turn embeds in U(1,1), whose realification embeds in Sp(4,R).

compositions.name: special pseudo-unitary determinant kernel into the real symplectic carrier
compositions.statement: The determinant-one subgroup SU(1,1) embeds through U(1,1) into Sp(4,R).

compositions.name: pseudo-unitary determinant-kernel exactness witness
compositions.statement: The SU(1,1) kernel inclusion followed by determinant is the trivial homomorphism SU(1,1) -> U(1).

compositions.name: rank-four unitary determinant-kernel exactness witness
compositions.statement: The SU(4) kernel inclusion followed by determinant is the trivial homomorphism SU(4) -> U(1).

compositions.name: identity component through the determinant-mu3 subgroup into U(4)
compositions.statement: SU(4) includes in the three-component determinant-mu3 subgroup, which is a proper subgroup of U(4).

compositions.name: finite-component determinant-kernel exactness witness
compositions.statement: The SU(4) kernel inclusion followed by restricted determinant is the trivial homomorphism SU(4) -> C3.

compositions.name: central scalar component through the determinant-mu3 subgroup into U(4)
compositions.statement: The scalar mu3 factor embeds centrally in H_4^(3) and hence in U(4).

compositions.name: SU(4) factor inclusion followed by its coordinate projection
compositions.statement: The SU(4) factor inclusion followed by first-coordinate projection is the identity homomorphism on SU(4).

compositions.name: C3 scalar factor inclusion followed by its coordinate projection
compositions.statement: The central C3 factor inclusion followed by second-coordinate projection is the identity homomorphism on C3.

compositions.name: SU(4) factor inclusion followed by the other coordinate projection
compositions.statement: The SU(4) factor inclusion followed by C3-coordinate projection is the trivial homomorphism SU(4) -> C3.

compositions.name: selected order-nine lift through the determinant-mu3 subgroup into U(4)
compositions.statement: The selected gauge-dressed C9 embeds in H_4^(3) and hence in U(4).

compositions.name: order-nine lift projected to the split component group
compositions.statement: Embedding the selected C9 and applying restricted determinant gives its surjective component quotient C9 -> C3, whose kernel is generated by U cubed.

compositions.name: cube subgroup annihilated by the ambient component projection
compositions.statement: The cube C3 kernel of the selected C9 lies in the SU(4) identity component, so its composite to the H_4^(3) component C3 is the trivial homomorphism.

compositions.name: first circle inclusion and projection in the maximal compact two-torus
compositions.statement: The first U(1) factor inclusion followed by first-coordinate projection is the identity homomorphism on U(1).

compositions.name: signature-(1,2) factor through the connected section stabilizer
compositions.statement: The carrier SO_0(1,2) factor embeds in the block stabilizer and hence in SO_0(2,3).

compositions.name: complementary boost factor through the connected section stabilizer
compositions.statement: The complementary SO_0(1,1) boost factor embeds in the block stabilizer and hence in SO_0(2,3).

compositions.name: carrier orthogonal factor inclusion followed by coordinate projection
compositions.statement: The SO_0(1,2) factor inclusion followed by its coordinate projection is the identity homomorphism.

compositions.name: integral symplectic reduction modulo 46 followed by the mod-2 CRT projection
compositions.statement: Reduction Sp(4,Z) -> Sp(4,Z/46Z) followed by the first CRT projection equals direct reduction modulo 2.

compositions.name: integral symplectic reduction modulo 46 followed by the mod-23 CRT projection
compositions.statement: Reduction Sp(4,Z) -> Sp(4,Z/46Z) followed by the second CRT projection equals direct reduction modulo 23.

compositions.name: mod-2 CRT factor inclusion followed by projection
compositions.statement: The Sp(4,F2) CRT factor inclusion followed by its coordinate projection is the identity.

compositions.name: mod-23 CRT factor inclusion followed by projection
compositions.statement: The Sp(4,F23) CRT factor inclusion followed by its coordinate projection is the identity.

compositions.name: dicyclic torus normalizer through the rank-one symplectic block
compositions.statement: Dic_11 embeds in Sp(4,F23) through SL(2,F23)=Sp(2,F23) acting on a chosen symplectic plane.

compositions.name: rank-one finite linear group through the B2-C2 symplectic block seam
compositions.statement: SL(2,F23) enters Spin(5,F23) by the degree-two symplectic identity, a selected block inclusion and the simply connected B2=C2 isomorphism.

compositions.name: complete finite-23 dicyclic-to-spin ladder
compositions.statement: The declared finite-field ladder gives a composable embedding of Dic_11 into simply connected Spin(5,F23).

compositions.name: first binary coordinate through V4 into the CRT module
compositions.statement: The first C2 primary coordinate enters the first C6 coordinate under componentwise CRT.

compositions.name: first binary coordinate through C6 into the first invariant factor
compositions.statement: The first C2 primary coordinate enters the first C6 invariant factor, agreeing with the primary-CRT route.

compositions.name: second binary coordinate through V4 into the CRT module
compositions.statement: The second C2 primary coordinate enters the second C6 coordinate under componentwise CRT.

compositions.name: second binary coordinate through C6 into the second invariant factor
compositions.statement: The second C2 primary coordinate enters the second C6 invariant factor, agreeing with the primary-CRT route.

compositions.name: first ternary coordinate through C3 squared into the CRT module
compositions.statement: The first C3 primary coordinate enters the first C6 coordinate under componentwise CRT.

compositions.name: first ternary coordinate through C6 into the first invariant factor
compositions.statement: The first C3 primary coordinate enters the first C6 invariant factor, agreeing with the primary-CRT route.

compositions.name: second ternary coordinate through C3 squared into the CRT module
compositions.statement: The second C3 primary coordinate enters the second C6 coordinate under componentwise CRT.

compositions.name: second ternary coordinate through C6 into the second invariant factor
compositions.statement: The second C3 primary coordinate enters the second C6 invariant factor, agreeing with the primary-CRT route.

compositions.name: first triangle permutation factor into the plus-type orthogonal group
compositions.statement: The first S3 factor permutes one triangle and embeds into O+(4,2) through the wreath-product model.

compositions.name: second triangle permutation factor into the plus-type orthogonal group
compositions.statement: The second S3 factor permutes the other triangle and embeds into O+(4,2) through the wreath-product model.

compositions.name: wreath-product swap-section roundtrip
compositions.statement: Including the block-swapping C2 and projecting back is the identity homomorphism on C2.

compositions.name: wreath-product base through the block-swap quotient
compositions.statement: The normal S3 x S3 base followed by the C2 quotient is the trivial homomorphism.

compositions.name: first S3 product-factor roundtrip
compositions.statement: First-factor inclusion followed by first projection is the identity homomorphism on S3.

compositions.name: second S3 product-factor roundtrip
compositions.statement: Second-factor inclusion followed by second projection is the identity homomorphism on S3.

compositions.name: first S3 factor through the second projection
compositions.statement: First-factor inclusion followed by second projection is the trivial homomorphism.

compositions.name: second S3 factor through the first projection
compositions.statement: Second-factor inclusion followed by first projection is the trivial homomorphism.

compositions.name: three-coordinate flag permutations into the shell orthogonal group
compositions.statement: The S3 flag factor embeds in O+(4,2) through the selected order-12 flag stabilizer.

compositions.name: two-coordinate flag permutation into the shell orthogonal group
compositions.statement: The C2 ~= S2 flag factor embeds in O+(4,2) through the selected order-12 flag stabilizer.

compositions.name: matched-parity block subgroup into the shell orthogonal group
compositions.statement: The order-18 matched-parity group embeds through the order-36 block base into O+(4,2).

compositions.name: matched-parity kernel through the mismatch character
compositions.statement: The matched-parity subgroup followed by the parity-mismatch quotient is the trivial homomorphism.

compositions.name: parity-mismatch section roundtrip
compositions.statement: The chosen one-factor transposition section followed by the mismatch quotient is the identity homomorphism on C2.

compositions.name: even-even base through the simultaneous-sign quotient
compositions.statement: The C3 x C3 normal base followed by the simultaneous-sign C2 quotient is the trivial homomorphism.

compositions.name: simultaneous-transposition section roundtrip
compositions.statement: The simultaneous-transposition C2 section followed by the semidirect projection is the identity homomorphism on C2.

compositions.name: first-projection C3 kernel composite
compositions.statement: The second-factor A3 kernel followed by first-coordinate projection is the trivial homomorphism.

compositions.name: first-coordinate diagonal-section roundtrip
compositions.statement: The diagonal S3 section followed by first-coordinate projection is the identity homomorphism on S3.

compositions.name: second-projection C3 kernel composite
compositions.statement: The first-factor A3 kernel followed by second-coordinate projection is the trivial homomorphism.

compositions.name: second-coordinate diagonal-section roundtrip
compositions.statement: The diagonal S3 section followed by second-coordinate projection is the identity homomorphism on S3.

compositions.name: explicit diagonal S3 through first projection
compositions.statement: The explicit diagonal S3 inclusion followed by first-coordinate projection is the identity homomorphism.

compositions.name: explicit diagonal S3 through second projection
compositions.statement: The explicit diagonal S3 inclusion followed by second-coordinate projection is the identity homomorphism.

compositions.name: C3 rotation subgroup through the S3 sign quotient
compositions.statement: The C3 kernel inclusion followed by the S3 sign quotient is the trivial homomorphism C3 -> C2.

compositions.name: inversion section through the S3 sign quotient
compositions.statement: The selected transposition C2 section followed by the S3 sign quotient is the identity homomorphism on C2.

compositions.name: colour cube-root phase into the ambient phase torus
compositions.statement: The colour C3 factor includes in the residual C3 x U(1) ambiguity and then in the original U(1) x U(1) phase torus.

compositions.name: unfixed weak phase into the ambient phase torus
compositions.statement: The full weak U(1) factor survives in the residual C3 x U(1) ambiguity and includes in the original phase torus.

compositions.name: conditional sixfold residual phase into the ambient torus
compositions.statement: Given the identified common volume, the finite C6 residual subgroup includes through C3 x U(1) into the original U(1) x U(1) ambiguity.

compositions.name: Tits group through its full automorphism factor into the Baby Monster
compositions.statement: The Tits simple group embeds in its full automorphism group, then in the second factor of S4 x ^2F4(2), and hence in the Baby Monster.

compositions.name: full Tits automorphism factor into the Baby Monster
compositions.statement: The full group ^2F4(2)=T:2 embeds as the second direct factor of a maximal Baby Monster subgroup.

compositions.name: Tits-local S4 factor into the Baby Monster
compositions.statement: The S4 factor of the Tits-local maximal product embeds in the Baby Monster.

compositions.name: central involution of 2.B into the Monster
compositions.statement: The central C2 kernel of 2.B -> B includes through the 2A centralizer into the Monster as its selected 2A involution.

compositions.name: selected Baby Monster Tits subgroup lifted compatibly through 2.B into the Monster
compositions.statement: The unique complement in the split pullback of the selected Baby Monster Tits subgroup embeds through 2.B into the Monster.

compositions.name: split C2 times Tits preimage into the Monster
compositions.statement: The full preimage C2 x T of the selected Baby Monster Tits subgroup embeds through the 2A centralizer into the Monster.
